name: Fer Factor
what_they_do: Lagos-based independent game development studio founded by Feranmi Oladosu building arcade, action, and cozy browser/mobile/PC titles including Tossdown (Steam), ChoreMaster, Gundotz, Kickshot, Null Fall, and Crate Crashers.
recent_activity: 2026-10-28: Selected among 10 studios for Google Play's $1M Indie Games Fund Africa for ChoreMaster (https://www.startuplist.africa/funding/fer-factor-grant-undisclosed-ed25f85); 2026-11-06: Profiled in African-Startups Indie Games Fund roundup (https://african-startups.com/news/funding/meet-the-10-african-gaming-studios-selected-for-google-plays-1-million-indie-games-fund/)
round_type: Non-dilutive Grant (Google Play Indie Games Fund Africa 2026)
amount: Not disclosed ($1M total fund across 10 studios)
marketing_titles_found: NONE (ferfactor.com and /press/ present a solo indie studio with no public team page or marketing, growth, or content title)
hiring_marketing_role: NO (no careers or open roles page on ferfactor.com)
unique_offer: Lagos indie game studio founded by Feranmi Oladosu delivering fast-paced, feel-first PC/browser/mobile games with 150K+ plays and 8M+ social engagements across TikTok and YouTube.
pitch_hook: Fer Factor won Google Play Indie Games Fund Africa backing on 2026-10-28 and draws 150K+ plays across 6 titles, yet ferfactor.com has no blog or devlog, links no official Instagram profile, and has no public marketing or growth lead beyond solo founder Feranmi Oladosu.
